# FoodLoop

> FoodLoop is a non-commercial surplus food listing tool for Kathmandu Valley. Restaurants post surplus meals, verified community kitchens find them on a map and coordinate same-day pickup.

## Site
- URL: https://foodloop.org
- Location: Kathmandu Valley, Nepal
- Contact: via registration on site

## Pages
- Home: https://foodloop.org/ — Restaurants post surplus meals, shelters collect them same day.
- How it works: https://foodloop.org/how-it-works — Three steps: post, discover, pickup.
- About: https://foodloop.org/about — Why FoodLoop exists and how verification works.
- Project status: https://foodloop.org/impact — Current scope and how impact will be measured.
- Join: https://foodloop.org/join — Choose restaurant or community kitchen.
- Explore: https://foodloop.org/explore — Public map of available food.
- Terms: https://foodloop.org/terms — Terms and food safety responsibilities.

## Notes
- No AI generated images.
- No fake metrics. Counts shown only after real donations are completed.
- Surplus handling and food safety remain the responsibility of participants.
